faces.transcription: Find card 58 from the Operations deck and place it faceup in the Operations area.
faces.flavor: "Sabik has compromised a number of dedicated agents, exploiting their desire to accomplish good. Your own optimism in the face of a growing threat is refreshing, but you must be cautious about who you trust on the outside, especially when sensitive intelligence is in play."
